user.title: Parcel Tracker Setup
user.description:
Enter your Ship24 API key to enable universal parcel tracking across 1500+ carriers.

Get a free key (10 shipments/month) at https://dashboard.ship24.com

init.title: Parcel Tracker Options
init.description:
Phone registration webhook: `{webhook_path}`. External registration access is disabled by default.

Ship24 tracking webhook: `{ship24_webhook_path}`. To enable push updates, enter your Ship24 webhook secret below and configure this path on your external HTTPS Home Assistant URL in the Ship24 dashboard. Keep both URLs private.

data_description.dhl_api_key: Optional. Provides direct status updates and delivery estimates for DHL parcels. Get a key at https://developer.dhl.com
data_description.destination_country_code: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 country code (for example DE). If set, this overrides Home location country.
data_description.destination_post_code: Optional recipient post code/ZIP. If set, this overrides Home location postal code.
data_description.cleanup_days: Number of days after a parcel is delivered before it is automatically removed (1-30)
data_description.scan_interval_hours: How often to poll Ship24 and optional DHL tracking (1-12 hours)
data_description.webhook_allow_external: Enable only when phone shortcuts need access through an external Home Assistant URL. Anyone with the webhook URL can register parcels.
data_description.ship24_webhook_secret: Use the secret allocated in the Ship24 webhook dashboard, not your API key. A nonempty secret enables the public tracking receiver; clear it to disable push updates. Polling remains enabled.

error.dhl_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to DHL API. Please check your API key.
error.invalid_country_code: Country code must be 2 or 3 letters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3), for example DE or DEU.
